scripts.title: Admin Commands
scripts.features:
Works with almost all executors
Prefix = "" -- Prefix is nil, just use commands like kill name
commands:
admin username -- Allows people to use admin commands
unadmin username -- removes admin from people
nots -- Removes TS effect
ts -- Stops time (broken as of now)
heal username amount -- Heal people with given amount
damage nick amount -- Damage people with given amount
stun username -- Stuns people
killnpc name -- Kills npc, can be used on dio like this killnpc dio
kill username -- Kills player
god username -- Gives player god mode
ungod username -- Removes godmode from player
goto Username -- Teleports you to the player
teleport FirstPlayer SecondPlayer -- Teleports the first player to the second player
bring username -- Brings the given player to you
